To: Tiffany Munoz
Cc: David Chang

Batches work well on our side. The most useful first batch is the license agreements and the list of patents and applications they grant against; that pair lets me set the search scope while the rest comes together.

I will open the searching against whatever is in that first batch for {{fact:f:E-2025-001.client}} and widen it as more arrives. If a document is still in draft, send the draft, and I will note the version so we are reading the right one.

Once the first Price-Henson batch is in, I will confirm the search scope back to you in a line, so you can see exactly what we are clearing. David Chang and I will keep this thread current as the batches land.
